visual_logic.pattern_strategy: Large, dark 'pebble' rosettes on a tan/ochre base, fully displayed across the broad lateral side flank.
visual_logic.color_palette: Deep violet-grey with white 'pebbled' spots on the flippers; rounded bulbous molar teeth visible within the jaw structure.
visual_logic.facial_silhouette: Short, rounded muzzle; visible blunt, globe-shaped crushing teeth shown clearly in a lateral profile view parallel to the frame edge.
visual_logic.environment: Deep blue water with a silty seafloor scattered with shell fragments. The seafloor elements are pushed into the low background layers to keep the underbelly silhouette crisp.

pose: The massive mosasaur is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original angled crushing action is stabilized into a straight, level cruising path, allowing the blunt-snouted head, robust torso, paddle-flippers, and heavy tail to stretch end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system. Sharp, geometric flecks of paint representing broken inoceramid shell fragments float horizontally behind the jaws to maintain a clean outline.
